record.field:
Aggregate records from any Odoo model using ORM read_group for analytics queries. Use this tool for totals and metrics such as sum, avg, min, max, and count.
Typical use cases: - "What is the sum of expenses this month?" - "Average invoice amount by salesperson" - "Count of leads by stage"
Parameters: - model: Odoo model name (for example, account.move.line) - domain: Odoo domain filter - aggregates: list of read_group aggregate expressions (for example, ["amount_total:sum", "id:count"]) - groupby: optional group-by fields - limit/orderby/lazy: optional read_group behavior controls
